assets.prompt: Create a professional ORIGINAL character IP concept sheet for a desktop AI assistant mascot. Landscape 3:2 canvas, high resolution, plain very light cool gray background, generous spacing, no cards or borders. Character: an ADULT 22-year-old pink-haired CATGIRL MAID, very moe and sweet in anime proportions but clearly an adult, absolutely original, NOT any existing Arknights or other franchise character. Art direction: Arknights: Endfield-inspired high-end anime game character illustration and industrial science-fiction costume language: exquisite crisp linework, clean controlled cel shading, delicately shaded physically believable fabric and hardware, polished gacha-game promotional concept art, NOT photoreal, NOT generic AI beauty portrait, not oily painterly realism. Face is especially important: round soft cheeks, short rounded chin, big luminous mint-aqua eyes with beautiful highlights and soft curved eyelashes, small nose, tiny smiling cat mouth, gentle pink blush, a playful affectionate expression, extremely adorable rather than mature glamour. Hair: pastel strawberry-milk PINK, fluffy short twin tails at shoulder length, airy bangs, a small heart-shaped ahoge; two large fluffy matching pink CAT EARS with ivory inner fur; NO human ears visible; ONE fluffy pink cat tail with an ivory tip. Distinctive design: a charcoal mini maid headband with ivory ruffles and one asymmetric muted-pink bow beside the left cat ear, an original tiny geometric two-ear pin, no franchise insignia. Costume: tasteful fully clothed charcoal and ivory MAID uniform, modest closed collar, short puff sleeves, ivory ruffled apron over a practical above-knee layered skirt, dusty rose ribbon bow and a SMALL original mint status jewel at collar; industrial sci-fi details kept subtle and elegant: compact rectangular utility pouch at waist, simple matte graphite buckles, a removable short technical apron panel, tidy seams and a tiny mechanical wrist cuff. Opaque black stockings and practical low-heeled black ankle shoes with small pink tabs. No cleavage, no garter display, no fetish framing, no weapon, no logos. A cute welcome-wave pose with a little head tilt and a naturally curling tail, fingers drawn accurately. Composition: LEFT 45 percent one large complete FULL BODY three-quarter front view from cat ear tips to shoes, not cropped, this is the hero and should be exquisitely appealing. UPPER RIGHT three large expression bust studies of EXACTLY SAME character: soft smile, delighted eyes-closed smile with tiny fang, focused helpful expression. LOWER RIGHT two complete matching 2.5-head-tall CHIBI DESKTOP PET versions: one standing and waving, one sitting adorably with curled tail. Chibi eyes are large, body tiny and plump, still the same hair/ears/headband/outfit/pin and palette. All drawings must be the same consistent character. Balanced colors: strawberry pink, charcoal, ivory, a TINY mint accent. No scenery, no UI, no extra characters, no glow clouds, no orbs, no watermark, no text except very small 'CONCEPT 01' in one corner. Prioritize an unforgettable cute face, strong instantly recognizable cat-ear/maid silhouette, and a polished brand mascot that works at both full-size and tiny desktop-pet size.

Use the supplied concept sheet ONLY as the exact character identity reference. Create ONE single transparent-background desktop pet asset, not a sheet, no surrounding panels. The exact same original pink-haired catgirl maid as the reference: fluffy strawberry-pink short twin tails, large matching cat ears with ivory inner fur, the identical charcoal and ivory ruffled maid headband and asymmetric dusty-rose bow, tiny geometric two-ear silver pin, mint-aqua eyes, small heart ahoge, charcoal and ivory maid dress with dusty-rose collar bow and little mint jewel, tiny graphite utility pouch, opaque black stockings, small black ankle boots, ONE pink fluffy tail with ivory tip. 2.5-head-tall CHIBI proportions, big round head and HUGE adorable mint eyes, very small plump body. Sitting with feet naturally forward, hands resting neatly on knees, tail curled to the viewer's right, face turned directly to viewer, warm tiny cat smile and light blush. Same polished premium anime game aesthetic as the reference, clean crisp high-quality linework with soft cel shading, detailed eyes, soft pink hair. Fully visible from ear tips and ahoge to shoes and entire tail, about 10 percent transparent padding all around; character fills canvas, centered. Simplify tiny costume details enough to stay legible when displayed 160 pixels tall. Absolutely transparent alpha background, NO floor, no drop shadow, no gray/white/checkerboard rectangle, no text, no logos, no watermark, no extra characters. Preserve the same cute face and all identifying accessories from the reference. This is a design preview of the mascot's desktop-pet form, not a new character.
